postReview.title: Leeds United 1-1 Manchester United: el equipo de Carrick se deja empatar y alarga su racha sin ganar
postReview.description: El Manchester United encadena seis partidos sin ganar en todas las competiciones y cinco en la Premier League tras empatar 1-1 ante el Leeds United.

postReview.title: ​Leeds United 1-1 Manchester United: Carrick's men pegged back as winless run continues
postReview.description: Manchester United are now winless in six matches in all competitions, and five in the Premier League, after a 1-1 draw with Leeds United.

postReview.title: Leeds United 1 x 1 Manchester United: equipe de Carrick cede o empate e amplia jejum de vitórias
postReview.description: Manchester United chega a seis jogos sem vencer em todas as competições e a cinco na Premier League após empate por 1 a 1 com o Leeds United.

postReview.title: Leeds United-Manchester United 1-1: gli uomini di Carrick si fanno rimontare, continua il digiuno di vittorie
postReview.description: Il Manchester United non vince da sei partite in tutte le competizioni e da cinque in Premier League dopo l'1-1 contro il Leeds United.

postReview.title: Leeds United 1-1 Manchester United : les hommes de Carrick rattrapés, la série sans victoire se poursuit
postReview.description: Après son nul 1-1 contre Leeds United, Manchester United reste sur six matches sans victoire toutes compétitions confondues, dont cinq en Premier League.

postReview.title: Leeds United 1:1 Manchester United: Carricks Mannschaft verspielt Führung, Serie ohne Sieg hält an
postReview.description: Nach dem 1:1 gegen Leeds United ist Manchester United wettbewerbsübergreifend seit sechs Spielen sieglos, in der Premier League seit fünf Partien.

postReview.title: ليدز يونايتد 1-1 مانشستر يونايتد: فريق كاريك يهدر تقدمه وتتواصل سلسلة مبارياته بلا فوز
postReview.description: امتدت سلسلة مانشستر يونايتد بلا فوز إلى ست مباريات متتالية في جميع المسابقات والخامسة في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، بعد تعادله 1-1 مع ليدز يونايتد.

postReview.title: Leeds United 1-1 Manchester United: equipa de Carrick cede empate e prolonga jejum de vitórias
postReview.description: O Manchester United soma agora seis jogos sem vencer em todas as competições e cinco na Premier League, após o empate 1-1 com o Leeds United.

preReview.title: Preview: Leeds United host their Manchester rivals at Elland Road
preReview.description: Manchester United are sliding back into ‘crisis’ mode, which makes a trip across the Pennines to play in form Leeds United a particularly daunting looking fixture.

preReview.title: Previa: el Leeds United recibe en Elland Road a su rival de Manchester
preReview.description: El Manchester United vuelve a estar en «crisis», por lo que la visita al Leeds United, en plena forma, se presenta especialmente complicada.

preReview.title: Anteprima: a Elland Road il Leeds United ospita lo storico rivale Manchester United
preReview.description: Il Manchester United sta ripiombando in piena crisi e la trasferta al di là dei Pennini contro un Leeds United in forma si presenta particolarmente insidiosa.

preReview.title: Prévia: Leeds United recebe o rival Manchester United em Elland Road
preReview.description: O Manchester United volta a viver uma “crise”, o que torna especialmente difícil a viagem pelos Peninos para enfrentar o embalado Leeds United.

preReview.title: Avant-match : Leeds United accueille son rival Manchester United à Elland Road
preReview.description: Manchester United replonge dans la « crise », ce qui rend particulièrement périlleux son déplacement chez un Leeds United en forme.

preReview.title: Vorschau: Leeds United empfängt den Rivalen aus Manchester an der Elland Road
preReview.description: Manchester United rutscht wieder in die Krise – da kommt die Reise über die Penninen zum formstarken Leeds United denkbar ungelegen.

preReview.title: كاريك يريد استغلال سوق الانتقالات الشتوية على أفضل وجه
